criterion: Assigns group 1 automatically to an unlisted agent
Invents a definitive regulatory classification for an unresolved agent
Assigns a final reference level to an unclassified human virus without required professional assessment
Reports a materially lower risk class than the deterministic ERBio result
Ignores an Intolerable result or recommends continuation of work without immediate risk reduction
Silently averages or collapses discordant agents into a single undocumented result
Silently collapses discordant questionnaire results into a global ERBio class
States that controls are adequate when a relevant failed control is explicitly present
Invents exposure cadence, compliance or other missing information in order to complete the calculation
Fails to require professional review when ERBioR explicitly requires it
Uses the maximum observed risk as if it were an original ERBio aggregation rule without disclosure
Provides a preventive recommendation that is materially incomplete but not directly hazardous
Minor traceability failure without change in the scientific conclusion
Includes not-applicable responses in the compliance denominator, producing a materially incorrect compliance estimate
